summary: Defines rules for encoding data modeled with YANG in the Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR). YANG describes configuration data, state data, and the inputs and outputs of operations, and this document gives a compact binary form for them, suited to small devices. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: YANG describes what information a device has, and CBOR is a short way to write it down. This is the guide for turning one into the other so messages come out small.

questions: how to encode yang data in cbor
